description: Assemble a blinking LED circuit using an ESP32, one LED, one resistor, and jumper wires.

steps.title: Scan Breadboard
steps.instruction: Point the camera at the breadboard to align the AR tracking.
steps.detail: This establishes the workspace for accurate AR guidance.

steps.title: Place the LED
steps.instruction: Insert the LED into the two highlighted holes. Long leg (+), Short leg (-).
steps.detail: Correct polarity is required for the LED to light.

steps.title: Place the resistor
steps.instruction: Insert the resistor between the two highlighted holes.
steps.detail: The resistor limits current through the LED.

steps.title: Connect LED to resistor
steps.instruction: Connect a jumper wire between the highlighted points.
steps.detail: This completes the LED path to the ESP32 output.

steps.title: Connect to ESP32 GPIO
steps.instruction: Connect the highlighted breadboard point to ESP32 GPIO 25.
steps.detail: This allows the ESP32 to control the LED.

steps.title: Connect to GND
steps.instruction: Connect the LED cathode to ESP32 GND.
steps.detail: This completes the circuit back to ground.

steps.title: Power and Upload
steps.instruction: Connect the ESP32 to USB and upload the blink program.
steps.detail: This powers the ESP32 and starts the program.

steps.title: Test the Circuit
steps.instruction: Run the program and verify that the LED blinks.

steps.title: Success!
steps.instruction: LED Blinking! The circuit is working correctly.
